verdict.rationale: INPI's own pages say the Guichet unique is fully dematerialised with no travel needed, and that it centralises the core formalities (registration, modifications, cessations, annual accounts, deposit of acts) in a single online entry point. Supporting documents are uploaded online, fees are paid by bank card through a secure module, and filings are signed electronically with a qualified certificate or via FranceConnect+. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that a founder actually completed a filing end-to-end online.
